task.text: Translate into french: The Bible never speaks anywhere of having an accountability partner. That way of avoiding sin is actually pursuing holiness through the fear of man - avoiding sin because of the shame of having to confess it to one's "accountability partner". But the Bible commands us to perfect holiness in the fear of God - not in the fear of man (2 Cor.7:1). We are accountable to God - "He is the only One with Whom we have to do" (Heb.4:13).

Take it wherever you think lands best — your framing, your tone, your examples. Make it compelling. French only please.
